title: The Chorus Student's Course
summary: A course that moves a student from sharing one note to swelling the voices of a whole company and clearing static from a friend.

title: Handbook of Shared Tones
summary: A handbook on holding a tone between two souls and building a bridge of tone along which soul technique may pass.

title: A Workbook of Mended Discord
summary: A workbook on finding the grating pitch between two allied souls and leading them back into a sweet and steady chord.

title: The Cadence Keeper's Guide
summary: A guide to marking and holding the closing beat of soul technique so that allies finish every phrase whole and in time.

title: Course in Joined Voices
summary: A course in joining several soul voices into one phrase so that the work of the group runs deeper than any single voice.
